description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteEditor' for editing notes within a note management system. It handles displaying, saving, and optionally deleting a note, with form inputs for title and content, and includes modal confirmation for deletion.
external_methods: Promise<void> onSave({ title: string; content: string })

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React component for editing a note, with functionalities for saving and deleting notes, and managing local state for input fields and modal confirmation.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles the save operation when the form is submitted, prevents default submit behavior, sets saving state, calls the onSave prop.
